2608.23817.title: A Formal Methodological Framework for Auditing Robustness and Fidelity in Explainable AI: From Application to Trust Certification
2608.23817.paper_summary: SHAP and LIME are now standard tools for interpreting black-box predictions, yet their outputs can vary substantially when the input is perturbed by small amounts of noise--a problem we observed firsthand in our previous work on food security in Madagascar (Ralinirina et al., 2025). This variability raises the question of whether such explanations can be trusted at all. We address it by constructing an auditing protocol that measures two properties of any post-hoc explainer: robustness (how stable the explanation is under input perturbation) and fidelity (whether the features deemed important actually drive the model's prediction). These two quantities are combined into a single Trust Score. We run the protocol on a multi-sectoral dataset from Madagascar (83 features, 253 records, 4 malnutrition classes) using three classifiers and two explainers, plus their regularized counterparts. The results are sobering: models with AUC above 0.99 can produce numerically degenerate or flatly uninformative explanations, and fidelity scores lose discriminative power when the model is overfitted. These findings suggest that auditing XAI outputs is not optional but necessary, particularly when they inform decisions in sensitive domains.
2608.23817.paper_summary_zh: SHAP 和 LIME 現在已成為解釋黑箱預測的標準工具，但當輸入受到小量噪音擾動時，它們的輸出可能會有顯著變化——這是我們在之前關於馬達加斯加食品安全的研究中親身觀察到的問題 (Ralinirina et al., 2025)。這種變異性引發了這樣的問題：這些解釋是否可以信任。我們通過構建一個審核協議來解決這個問題，該協議測量任何事後解釋器的兩個特性：穩健性（在輸入擾動下解釋的穩定性）和忠實度（被認為重要的特徵是否實際驅動模型的預測）。這兩個量結合成一個單一的信任分數。我們在來自馬達加斯加的多部門數據集上運行該協議（83個特徵，253條記錄，4個營養不良類別），使用三個分類器和兩個解釋器，以及它們的正則化對應物。結果令人警醒：AUC 超過 0.99 的模型可能會產生數值退化或完全無信息的解釋，並且當模型過擬合時，忠實度分數會失去區分能力。這些發現表明，審核 XAI 輸出不是可選的，而是必要的，特別是當它們影響敏感領域的決策時。
